verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents that double-entry bookkeeping runs on a chart of accounts and offers cost centres as a tagging dimension for invoices and receipts, with filtering and analysis by cost centre. Nothing shows the accountant can customize the chart of accounts itself. missing for 10: evidence of editing or adding accounts in the chart of accounts, account-type configuration, sub-account hierarchies, class/tag dimensions beyond cost centres, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Double-entry bookkeeping is carried out using a chart of accounts.
Assign invoices and receipts to different cost centres. You can then filter by cost centre and analyse the income and expenses assigned to each one.
